( 1. 北京大学第一医院，a. 药剂科; b. 儿科，北京 100034; 2. 深圳市宝安区妇幼保健院药剂科，广东深圳 518106)SHEN Xin － tian1a，2 ，CHEN Chao － yang1a，ZHANG Li － li1a ，WEN Di1a，WU Ri － han1a，ZHONG Xu － hui1b，ZHOU Ying1a，CUI Yi － min1a Abstract: Objective To explore the role of clinical pharmacist in the treatment of pediatric nephrotic syndrome complicated with Helicobacter pylori ( Hp) infection. Methods Clinical pharmacists participated in the treatment of a child with nephrotic syndrome complicated with Hp infection，optimized the medication regimen，and reduced adverse drug interactions through rapid access to pharmaceutical information. Results and conclusion The child improved and was discharged from hospital. Results and conclusion The child improved and was discharged from hospital. Clinical pharmacists timely warned the possible drug interaction between omeprazole and clarithromycin and tacrolimus，maintaining the efficacy of tacrolimus in the treatment of nephrotic syndrome and avoiding serious drug interactions.( 1. a. Department of Pharmacy， Baoan Maternal and Child Helth Hospital，Shenzhen 518106，Guangdong Province，China)原发性儿童肾病综合征( NS) 占同期泌尿系疾病住院患儿总数的20%，他克莫司联合小剂量泼尼松是治疗激素耐药 NS 的首选药物。 持续感染是导致 NS 复发的关键因素，预防和治疗感染是治疗NS 的前提［1］。 一项临床研究表明［2］，对于膜性肾病合并幽门螺旋菌$\mathrm { ( \ H p ) }$ 阳性患者，根治 $\mathrm { H p }$ 可使24 h 尿蛋白水平从( $2 . 4 2 \pm 3 . 2 4 ) \ \mathrm { \Omega } _ { \pm }$ g 降低至 $\left( 1 . 2 6 \pm 1 . 7 3 \right)$ g( $P < 0 . 0 5 )$ ，提示合并 $\mathrm { H p }$ 感染的 NS 应加强抗 $\mathrm { H p }$ 治疗，有利于控制NS。 本例报道 NS 合并 $\mathrm { H p }$ 感染时 $^ { \bullet 2 }$ 种疾病首选药物联用致药物相互作用及临床药师参与用药风险管理。
